source: CAOP2025 (Carta Administrativa Oficial de Portugal, Direção-Geral do Território), fetched 2026-10-29 from ogcapi.dgterritorio.gov.pt: the 24 freguesias (parishes) of the City of Lisbon by name, and the other 17 municipalities of the Área Metropolitana de Lisboa by town name; simplified to ~10 m, islets under 0.01 km2 dropped (D-380).
